entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maha Thammaracha I, born as Li Thai, was King of Sukhothai. He was the first Buddhist philosopher to write in the Thai language. He reigned from roughly 1347 until his death in 1368. Li Thai was the son of Loe Thai and the grandson of Ram Khamhaeng the Great.
